# Empty state: `jl-empty`

What a list, a table or a page shows when it has nothing yet, and the way to fill it.

- Class `JlEmpty`, a molecule: `import { JlEmpty } from '@syware/jlib';`
- On the site: https://bioleyl.github.io/jlib/components/empty

An empty state replaces a list, a table or a page that has nothing to show yet. It says why, in a
sentence, and offers the way out: the button that creates the first item, or clears the filters that hid them all.

md suits a page or a section; sm suits a card or a panel.

## Use

```ts
import { JlButton, JlEmpty } from '@syware/jlib';
```

```tsx
<JlEmpty
  description="Projects keep your pages, files and people together."
  heading="No projects yet"
  icon="folder"
>
  <JlButton variant="primary" icon="plus" label="New project" />
</JlEmpty>
```

```html
<jl-empty
  description="Projects keep your pages, files and people together."
  heading="No projects yet"
  icon="folder"
>
  <jl-button variant="primary" icon="plus" label="New project"></jl-button>
</jl-empty>
```

## Properties

Inputs: a JSX prop sets one, code calls `.set(value)` and `.get()`, HTML writes the attribute (lists and objects as JSON).

- `icon` (attribute `icon`): `string`, default `'inbox'`. The icon in the circle; none shows no icon.
- `heading` (attribute `heading`): `string`, default `''`. What is empty, or why.
- `description` (attribute `description`): `string`, default `''`. A sentence that says what to do.
- `size` (attribute `size`): `'sm' | 'md'`, default `'md'`. md for a page or a section, sm for a card or a panel.

## Slots

- The default slot: The buttons that fill it.

## Styling

- `base` (part, `::part(base)`): The empty state.

## Examples

HTML as the site renders it, with its layout classes (`row`, `stack`, `narrow`, `muted`), which are not jlib's: a view writes the same components by class in JSX. A script's `root` is the example's element.

### A first use

```html
<jl-empty icon="folder" heading="No projects yet" description="Projects keep your pages, files and people together. Create one to start.">
  <jl-button variant="primary" icon="plus" label="New project"></jl-button>
  <jl-button label="Import"></jl-button>
</jl-empty>
```

### No results

When filters hide everything, offer to clear them.

```html
<jl-empty icon="search" heading="No results for “invoice 2019”" description="Check the spelling, or search all folders.">
  <jl-button variant="ghost" label="Clear the search"></jl-button>
</jl-empty>
```

### Small, in a card

sm, inside a card.

```html
<jl-card class="narrow" heading="Notifications">
  <jl-empty size="sm" icon="bell" heading="You are all caught up" description="New mentions and replies show here."></jl-empty>
</jl-card>
```
